verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 6.34
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 6.34

verses.pali: 4. Devatāvagga
verses.english: 4. Deities

verses.pali: Mahāmoggallānasutta
verses.english: With Mahāmoggallāna

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṁ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
verses.english: Then as Venerable Mahāmoggallāna was in private retreat this thought came to his mind,

verses.pali: “katamesānaṁ devānaṁ evaṁ ñāṇaṁ hoti:
verses.english: “Which gods know that they are

verses.pali: ‘sotāpannā nāma avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’”ti?
verses.english: stream-enterers, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening?”

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena tisso nāma bhikkhu adhunākālaṅkato aññataraṁ brahmalokaṁ upapanno hoti.
verses.english: Now, at that time a monk named Tissa had recently passed away and been reborn in a realm of divinity.

verses.pali: Tatrapi naṁ evaṁ jānanti:
verses.english: There they knew that

verses.pali: “tisso brahmā mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo”ti.
verses.english: The divinity Tissa was very mighty and powerful.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno—seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṁ vā bāhaṁ pasāreyya pasāritaṁ vā bāhaṁ samiñjeyya; evamevaṁ—jetavane antarahito tasmiṁ brahmaloke pāturahosi.
verses.english: And then Venerable Mahāmoggallāna, as easily as a strong person would extend or contract their arm, vanished from Jeta’s Grove and reappeared in that realm of divinity.

verses.pali: Addasā kho tisso brahmā āyasmantaṁ mahāmoggallānaṁ dūratova āgacchantaṁ.
verses.english: Tissa saw Moggallāna coming off in the distance,

verses.pali: Disvāna āyasmantaṁ mahāmoggallānaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: and said to him,

verses.pali: “ehi kho, mārisa moggallāna; svāgataṁ, mārisa moggallāna;
verses.english: “Come, my good fellow Moggallāna! Welcome, my good fellow!

verses.pali: cirassaṁ kho, mārisa moggallāna; imaṁ pariyāyamakāsi, yadidaṁ idhāgamanāya.
verses.english: It’s been a long time since you took the opportunity to come here.

verses.pali: Nisīda, mārisa moggallāna, idamāsanaṁ paññattan”ti.
verses.english: Sit, my good Moggallāna, this seat is for you.”

verses.pali: Nisīdi kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno paññatte āsane.
verses.english: Moggallāna sat down on the seat spread out.

verses.pali: Tissopi kho brahmā āyasmantaṁ mahāmoggallānaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi.
verses.english: Then Tissa bowed to Moggallāna and sat to one side.

verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho tissaṁ brahmānaṁ āyasmā mahāmoggallāno etadavoca:
verses.english: Moggallāna said to him,

verses.pali: “Katamesānaṁ kho, tissa, devānaṁ evaṁ ñāṇaṁ hoti: ‘sotāpannā nāma avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’”ti?
verses.english: “Tissa, which gods know that they are stream-enterers, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening?”

verses.pali: “Cātumahārājikānaṁ kho, mārisa moggallāna, devānaṁ evaṁ ñāṇaṁ hoti: ‘sotāpannā nāma avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’”ti.
verses.english: “The gods of the four great kings know this.”

verses.pali: “Sabbesaññeva nu kho, tissa, cātumahārājikānaṁ devānaṁ evaṁ ñāṇaṁ hoti: ‘sotāpannā nāma avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’”ti?
verses.english: “But do all of them know this?”

verses.pali: “Na kho, mārisa moggallāna, sabbesaṁ cātumahārājikānaṁ devānaṁ evaṁ ñāṇaṁ hoti: ‘sotāpannā nāma avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’ti.
verses.english: “No, my good Moggallāna, not all of them.

verses.pali: Ye kho te, mārisa moggallāna, cātumahārājikā devā buddhe aveccappasādena asamannāgatā dhamme aveccappasādena asamannāgatā saṅghe aveccappasādena asamannāgatā ariyakantehi sīlehi asamannāgatā na tesaṁ devānaṁ evaṁ ñāṇaṁ hoti: ‘sotāpannā nāma avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’ti.
verses.english: Those who lack experiential confidence in the Buddha, the teaching, and the Saṅgha, and lack the ethics loved by the noble ones, do not know that they are stream-enterers.

verses.pali: Ye ca kho te, mārisa moggallāna, cātumahārājikā devā buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatā, dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgatā, saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgatā ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgatā, tesaṁ evaṁ ñāṇaṁ hoti: ‘sotāpannā nāma avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’”ti.
verses.english: But those who have experiential confidence in the Buddha, the teaching, and the Saṅgha, and have the ethics loved by the noble ones, do know that they are stream-enterers.”

verses.pali: “Cātumahārājikānaññeva nu kho, tissa, devānaṁ evaṁ ñāṇaṁ hoti: ‘sotāpannā nāma avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’ti udāhu tāvatiṁsānampi devānaṁ …pe…
verses.english: “But Tissa, is it only the gods of the four great kings who know that they are stream-enterers, or do the gods of the thirty-three …

verses.pali: yāmānampi devānaṁ …
verses.english: the gods of Yama …

verses.pali: tusitānampi devānaṁ …
verses.english: the joyful gods …

verses.pali: nimmānaratīnampi devānaṁ …
verses.english: the gods who love to create …

verses.pali: paranimmitavasavattīnampi devānaṁ evaṁ ñāṇaṁ hoti: ‘sotāpannā nāma avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’”ti?
verses.english: and the gods who control what is created by others know that they are stream-enterers, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening?”

verses.pali: “Paranimmitavasavattīnampi kho, mārisa moggallāna, devānaṁ evaṁ ñāṇaṁ hoti: ‘sotāpannā nāma avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’”ti.
verses.english: “The gods of these various classes know this.”

verses.pali: “Sabbesaññeva nu kho, tissa, paranimmitavasavattīnaṁ devānaṁ evaṁ ñāṇaṁ hoti: ‘sotāpannā nāma avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’”ti?
verses.english: “But do all of them know this?”

verses.pali: “Na kho, mārisa moggallāna, sabbesaṁ paranimmitavasavattīnaṁ devānaṁ evaṁ ñāṇaṁ hoti: ‘sotāpannā nāma avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’ti.
verses.english: “No, my good Moggallāna, not all of them.

verses.pali: Ye kho te, mārisa moggallāna, paranimmitavasavattī devā buddhe aveccappasādena asamannāgatā, dhamme aveccappasādena asamannāgatā, saṅghe aveccappasādena asamannāgatā, ariyakantehi sīlehi asamannāgatā, na tesaṁ devānaṁ evaṁ ñāṇaṁ hoti: ‘sotāpannā nāma avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’ti.
verses.english: Those who lack experiential confidence in the Buddha, the teaching, and the Saṅgha, and lack the ethics loved by the noble ones, do not know that they are stream-enterers.

verses.pali: Ye ca kho te, mārisa moggallāna, paranimmitavasavattī devā buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatā, dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgatā, saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgatā, ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgatā tesaṁ evaṁ ñāṇaṁ hoti: ‘sotāpannā nāma avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’”ti.
verses.english: But those who have experiential confidence in the Buddha, the teaching, and the Saṅgha, and have the ethics loved by the noble ones, do know that they are stream-enterers.”

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno tissassa brahmuno bhāsitaṁ abhinanditvā anumoditvā: “seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṁ vā bāhaṁ pasāreyya, pasāritaṁ vā bāhaṁ samiñjeyya; evamevaṁ: ‘brahmaloke antarahito jetavane pāturahosī’”ti.
verses.english: Moggallāna approved and agreed with what the divinity Tissa said. Then, as easily as a strong person would extend or contract their arm, he vanished from that realm of divinity and reappeared in Jeta’s Grove.

verses.pali: Catutthaṁ.
